title: The verdict door reads a ! head and refuses an unrunnable instrument before running any
intention: The verdict door reads an instrument opening with the shell's ! negation as a command, and refuses any unrunnable instrument before it runs a single one.
why: Measured on ticket 284798998ab0 (idea 8d19bdddfde4, 2026-10-30): an instrument '! grep ...' was refused as carrying no command, and only AFTER the slow instruments before it had run (about 85 minutes of reading thrown away for a parse refusal).
traces_to: Law 1 (a thrown-away reading is a re-derivation), Law 7 (the refusal names the real cause at once), Law 8 (the verdict door is part of proving).
how: One constant and one loop in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py; proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_the_verdict_door_refuses_before_it_runs.py.
falsifier: Done when (1) extract_command('! grep -q x README.md') returns that command; (2) observe_instruments over an artifact whose first verdict entry is runnable and whose last is not makes zero runner calls (injected counting runner) and returns both readings with runnable True/False; (3) an all-runnable artifact still calls the runner once per entry; (4) the existing verdict proofs stay green. The hollow revert of verdict.py reds (1) and (2). Wrong intent if a green verdict over a real chain changes outcome.

decisions.text: D1: In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py, add "!" to the _SHELL_HEADS frozenset (line 156). shlex.split puts '!' as its own first token, so _first_token_runs reads '! grep -q x f' as a command.

D2: In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py observe_instruments (line 302), first build one reading per dict entry in artifact['verdicts'] (claim, instrument, outcome, expect_exit) with its command = extract_command(entry['instrument'], where). If any command is None, set reading['runnable'] = (command is not None) on every reading and return the list without calling runner even once.

D3: Otherwise (every command extracted) run each as today: reading['runnable'] = True, reading['run'] = runner(command, timeout_s=_declared(criterion, entry, 'timeout_s', _TIMEOUT_DEFAULT), cwd=where). write_verdict and _observed_entries are unchanged.

D4: The proof is cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_the_verdict_door_refuses_before_it_runs.py (red-first, written before the build): tooth 1 extract_command('! grep -q x README.md', root) returns the string; tooth 2 observe_instruments over {'verdicts': [runnable entry, unrunnable entry]} with a counting runner makes 0 calls and returns 2 readings runnable [True, False]; tooth 3 an all-runnable artifact calls the runner once per entry. Each tooth prints 'ok <name>'; the module is imported at call time with importlib; the file ends with print_teeth_main(__file__).
D5: Step 1: write the build per D1-D3 in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/verdict.py.

D6: Step 2: run bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_the_verdict_door_refuses_before_it_runs.py': teeth 1-3 green; tooth 4 stays red until Step 3, because cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_chart_verdict.py has been red since 2026-10-30 (D7 fixes it). The seven files in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/ are: test_a_live_logs_miss_names_its_cause.py, test_an_instrument_runs_under_the_seal.py, test_chart_verdict.py, test_falsifier_verdict.py, test_the_instrument_is_run.py, test_verdict_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, test_the_verdict_door_refuses_before_it_runs.py.

D7: Measured 2026-11-05: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_chart_verdict.py test_import_allowlist_tree_free has been red since commit 878131f2 (2026-10-30), because verdict.py imports cairn.tools.base.script_argv, which its allow tuple (line 554) does not name. Fix by the precedent of ticket d8e8a2dc1176 D2: add 'cairn.tools.base.script_argv' to the allow tuple AND, beside the gate-tool assert at line 562, assert sorted(import_map(script_argv.__file__)['measured']['imports']) == ['__future__', 'os', 'pathlib', 'shutil'] (measured 2026-11-05), importing cairn.tools.base.script_argv inside the test function. The file also gains PROVES = {'0d38d0f5a4e3': {'4': 'test_import_allowlist_tree_free'}} with a comment naming the ticket and that no tooth was removed, because the tester's rung 4 (cairn/devices/tester/reseal.py:350) seals a changed proof only when a code-seam's PROVES names it.

D8: The proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_the_verdict_door_refuses_before_it_runs.py carries a fourth tooth test_the_standing_verdict_proofs_stay_green, declared as PROVES key '4': it runs each of the six other files in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/ with subprocess ([sys.executable, path], cwd=ROOT, timeout 300) and asserts every exit is 0, naming the failing file and its output tail.

D9: Step 3: apply D7 to cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_chart_verdict.py, then run each of the seven files in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/ (test_a_live_logs_miss_names_its_cause.py, test_an_instrument_runs_under_the_seal.py, test_chart_verdict.py, test_falsifier_verdict.py, test_the_instrument_is_run.py, test_verdict_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, test_the_verdict_door_refuses_before_it_runs.py) with bin/cairn test --exec 'python3 <file>' twice; every one exits 0, tooth 4 included.

D10: test_falsifier_verdict.py tooth test_the_real_ticket_that_built_this_form_yields_its_clauses reads the live ticket beside-else-home (falsifier_criteria root= the repo whose parent holds CairnCommons/tickets, else ~/dev/src/cairn), and its PROVES names 0d38d0f5a4e3 clause 4 — so tooth 4 holds in hollow's commons-less worktree (measured: it was the one sibling red there)
